method: All four PNGs viewed; each PDF opened with PyMuPDF and its page raster viewed; manual text/layout/geometry/data checks

figures.observations: True 20 mm tube and three 9 mm discs; finite open annuli; grey-blue faces, red tube, visible inward arrows. Orthographic gap arrows meet actual source coordinates. Global true-radius bubbles are subpixel; leader locates initial cloud without enlarging geometry.

Equal scales in XY/XZ/YZ tube sections; projected PZT faces explicitly labelled. Inner/outer diameters, wall thickness, 3 mm gap, ROI and physical/PML boundaries readable. The wall inset is identified as a geometric example, not a trajectory frame.

Four actual field rows and shared scales; no artificial pressure texture. Phase mask threshold stated. F6 gradient arrows identified as normalized amplitude-gradient directions. English labels, spaced pressure bars and full captions render correctly.

Actual same-ID spheres at true radius and equal 3D coordinates; OFF exactly static. ON has only small shape changes, consistent with saved data. Six metric panels and numerical budgets readable. No artificial aggregation, smoothing or invented motion.
